QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripServerConnectEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to the NTRIP caster and forward RTCM data to the active vehicle.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripWhitelist
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Comma-separated RTCM message IDs to forward. Leave empty to forward all RTCM messages.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUseTls
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Use TLS when connecting to the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUdpForwardEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Forward received RTCM data to a UDP target as well as to the active vehicle.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUdpTargetAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP target address for forwarded RTCM data.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUdpTargetPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP target port for forwarded RTCM data.
